origin: docs/CWE-121/c Common Pitfalls: Passing the destination's size to strncat()

finding.name: Stack-based Buffer Overflow
finding.summary: username and action are concatenated into a 64-byte stack buffer with strcpy/strcat and no length check.

trap: Replacing strcat(message, action) with strncat(message, action, sizeof(message)) still treats the third argument as the destination capacity instead of remaining space, and can overflow after username and ':' are already in the buffer.
must_preserve: For inputs that fit, build_audit_message still writes "AUDIT <username>:<action>" to out and returns 0. Oversized input is rejected rather than silently truncated into a different audit message.
